Game Overview

In Squareking of Easter, the core idea is straightforward: help the square king escape a trap-laden castle filled with cunning monsters. Collect Easter eggs to unlock your way to freedom, evading sharp blades and relentless foes in a thrilling and dynamic dash for the exit. Can you outwit the castle's devious defenses and make your escape?
